It can be seen that there has been positive effect of the MPL and online assesment approach on the students’ grades in the ‘In -COVID semester’. The improvement of the student perofrmance in the MPL implementation during the COVID teaching period was also confirmed using the z-test using R-software where the below hypothesis were accepted using the statistics in Figure 5.
